thread:
Nina Patel: Draft for the product launch blog (Optimize) is in the doc. Need: editorial polish, legal on benchmark language, and final CTA/UTM mapping for HubSpot. Doc: https://docs.google.com/document/d/optimize-draft

Ethan Moore: dropping by to do a tone pass. main ask: hero should be benefit-first not technical.

Priya Das: Agreed. I'll add two short hero variants in the doc. Also: add a one-line customer quote above the benchmarks if we can get one from AE.

Nina Patel: added a placeholder customer quote and a short test appendix with model/config notes. Bench claim currently: "20-40% lower per-token cost via batching + prefix caching"

legal-bot: Automated scan: flagged comparative claim. Please include context: test harness, confidence interval, and a note that results vary.

Nina Patel: updating to: "Typical 20-40% per-token cost reduction observed in our internal tests; results may vary by model and prompt." Will add footnote with test params.

Sam Torres: Ops asked whether we should publish throughput numbers per GPU. Might help enterprise readers. Any objections?

Ethan Moore: fine to include but keep it as an example table and add a "typical" caveat.

Nina Patel: adding a small ops table and marking it as example. Assigned @crm-bot to confirm HubSpot flow details.

crm-bot: HubSpot form id: 98765. CTA link should include utm_source=blog, utm_medium=post, utm_campaign=optimize_launch_2026. Suggest using the landing URL: https://redwood.com/optimize?utm_source=blog&utm_medium=post&utm_campaign=optimize_launch_2026

Riley Gomez: For lead routing: map registrants to list "Optimize_Launch_2026" and tag "optimize_launch". Hot lead rule: if (attended && demo_request == true) => owner = sales-qual, priority = high

Nina Patel: adding mapping snippet to the doc:
```
if attended && demo_request:
  assign_to: sales-qual
  priority: high
elif registered:
  nurture_flow: product-webinar
  tags: [optimize_launch]
```

Priya Das: hero variants in doc: 1) "Cut inference cost. Keep output quality." 2) "Spend less on inference, not less on results." 3) "Faster, cheaper LLM inference—for production." Pick one and I'll refine body tone.

Ethan Moore: prefer #1 but tweak to "Cut inference cost—keep output quality." (em dash).

legal-bot: Please add footnote with test harness: model=llama-3-13b, seq_len_p95=512, batching=dynamic, n_runs=10, hardware=A100-80GB. Also avoid absolute words like "guarantee".

Nina Patel: noted. I've appended the footnote and replaced any 'guarantee' phrasing. Plan: finish edits and request legal quick-pass. If legal signs off today we can slot publish for tomorrow 11:00 PT.

Sam Torres: I'll double-check throughput numbers with eng-runbooks and confirm the ops caveat.

Riley Gomez: Once legal clears, I'll provision the HubSpot form mapping and webhook to tag attendees.

Priya Das: small copy nit: add a two-line summary for social posts under "shareables" in the doc. I'll draft now.

Nina Patel: thanks all. Final checklist: hero finalized, legal quick-pass, HubSpot mapping live, ops table caveat confirmed, customer quote replaced. Ping me when each is done and I'll request publish slot. :rocket:
